prose: A short antirez post titled 'AI cybersecurity is not proof of work.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: Sanfilippo pushes back on treating AI security findings as inherently valuable - volume of automated reports is not evidence of real vulnerabilities or real work. The concrete targets of the argument (bug bounties, vendors, hype) are unknown from the capture.
highlights: antirez: AI cybersecurity is not proof of work
Against equating automated security output with demonstrated value
Title only; the argument's substance unknown
